subject: Request: Trial extension & promotional credits for digitization project
messages:
From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@commarchives.org>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Helen Cho <h.choi@uni-example.edu>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Trial extension & promotional credits for digitization project

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput numbers were really helpful. We're a small nonprofit that runs a community-led digitization program (Community Archives Network). We're trying to run a supervised OCR + LLM-assisted metadata enrichment pipeline over 2.5M scanned pages for a multi-university replication project led by Dr. Cho.

Two asks:
- Would Redwood consider a 3-month trial extension and a promotional credit to cover early-stage experimentation (we're budget-constrained and this is funded by a small fellowship)?
- We also need a short statement or summary of data handling practices (retention, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, and whether the hosted API processes can be configured to avoid storing training data) to satisfy our institutional review board / grant administrator.

I've attached a one-pager about the project for context. Happy to provide more details or hop on a quick call. Our timeline is tight — the replication team plans to ingest the first tranche on Nov 15.

Warmly,
Sam Lewis
Program Director | Community Archives Network
sam.lewis@commarchives.org
(415) 555-0183

Attachment: project-onepager.docx (1.2 MB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@commarchives.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension & promotional credits for digitization project

Hi Sam — great to meet you over the demo.

Thanks for the one-pager, this looks like an impactful use case and the timeline makes sense. Quick answers:
- We can typically grant short promotional credit packages and trial extensions for verified nonprofit research partners. I'll bring this to Marissa (sales) and Ben (partnerships) for a formal proposal.
- For the IRB/grant office, I can share our SOC2 summary and a redact-friendly note on data handling and retention. That should cover encryption and training-data concerns.

I've looped in Marissa to draft the credits offer and Ben to coordinate any partner paperwork. Could you confirm the expected monthly token/embedding volume range for the initial ingestion? That helps us size a promo.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com

Attachment: —
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@commarchives.org>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension & promotional credits for digitization project

Hi Sam — thanks for the background and the one-pager (looks great).

We'd be happy to support Community Archives Network with a promotional package. To get things moving I can offer:
- $6,000 in platform credits applied over 3 months (applies to hosted API usage only)
- A 90-day trial extension with no baseline billing until Mar 15, 2028 for the first tranche

These offers are subject to a quick nonprofit verification and acceptance of promo terms (I attached the standard promo-credit-terms.txt). If you can confirm the expected monthly usage bands (tokens / embeddings) and a contact for nonprofit verification (financial contact or grant letter), I will open a HubSpot deal and route this for approval.

Ben — can you help with the nonprofit verification checklist and any partnership MSA needs?

Sam — attaching our SOC2 summary and a short FAQ on data handling that addresses IRB questions (SOC2_summary.pdf and data_FAQ.txt). Let me know if you need a more formal attestation.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (120 KB), promo-credit-terms.txt (2 KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@commarchives.org>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension & promotional credits for digitization project

Thanks Marissa — happy to take this.

Sam, quick checklist items we usually need for nonprofit promos:
- Short nonprofit verification (EIN or equivalent) or a signed grant letter from your funder
- Point of contact for billing/finance approval (name + email)
- Expected peak tokens/day (estimate is fine) and whether you'll be using embeddings at scale

If you want to expedite, send a scanned EIN and a copy of the grant award email and we'll fast-track. Once verified I can attach a simple addendum to the promo offer.

I'll start a HubSpot record and drop the draft MSA link to you after verification.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
